title: BrainTrustCrypto Provenance Manifest
description: Offline provenance and human-review manifest (Phase 1B.3A/1B.3C.2A/1B.3C.2B.2B), schema 1.2.0. Every new manifest defaults to NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW. Secrets, credentials, and full sensitive prompts are never recorded; only prompt hashes are stored. Existing 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 manifests remain valid and are only upgraded through explicit migration functions; they are never silently reinterpreted or overwritten. Schema 1.2.0 adds immutable claim_id for every factual claim; claim_id is conditionally required (and non-null) only when task.schema_version is 1.2.0 — 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 manifests remain valid without it.

schema_version.description: New manifests are 1.2.0; 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 manifests remain valid for read/validate and explicit migration only

local_path.description: Path relative to the task directory

prompt_hash.description: SHA-256 of the prompt only; the full sensitive prompt is never stored

source_url.description: Required for provider assets; optional for local/ai_generated

provider.description: Required for provider and ai_generated assets

license_evidence.description: License evidence/reference; required for every asset including local

claim_id.description: Immutable claim identifier derived from SHA-256 of canonical JSON (task_id, ordinal, normalized claim_text, source_url). Required and non-null for schema 1.2.0 via the top-level allOf conditional below; optional and nullable for legacy 1.0.0/1.1.0 manifests (a present string must still match the pattern). Uniqueness within the manifest is enforced by Python validation; JSON Schema cannot express array uniqueness.

source_url.description: May satisfy the VERIFIED supporting-HTTPS-URL requirement

reviewer.description: Legacy 1.0.0 accountability field; required for VERIFIED/RETRACTED when reviewer_id is not used

review_date.description: Legacy 1.0.0 accountability field; required for VERIFIED/RETRACTED when review_timestamp_utc is not used

supporting_sources.description: Schema 1.1.0: optional additional supporting URLs; a VERIFIED claim needs at least one valid HTTPS URL across source_url and supporting_sources

reviewer_display_name.description: Schema 1.1.0 reviewer display name; control characters rejected

notes.description: Schema 1.1.0: explanatory notes; required for RETRACTED claims using the 1.1.0 reviewer identity fields

parameters.description: Non-secret generation parameters only; credential-like keys are rejected

review_status.description: REVOKED is intentionally NOT a value; revocation is recorded via receipt, never by mutating output.review_status

filename_marker.description: Filename carrying the __NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW marker while unreviewed

allOf.description: Version-conditional claim_id: schema 1.2.0 requires a non-null claim_id matching ^claim-[0-9a-f]{32}$ for every factual claim; legacy 1.0.0/1.1.0 manifests are unaffected and remain valid without claim_id
